verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service with an MCP server and an enterprise mention of programmatic API queries, so a versioning and deprecation axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API versions and no deprecation policy. The vendor's MCP reference explicitly states there is no versioning or changelog surface, and no REST API or OpenAPI document; probes for OpenAPI paths all return 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
